description.en: Reverse-engineering MCP bridges (IDA, jadx, idalib), browser/computer-use enabler, whale-tail UI, and opencode agent presets. Published on npm, installable as a third-party plugin market source.
description.zh: 逆向 MCP 桥接（IDA、jadx、idalib）、浏览器/电脑控制启用器、鲸鱼尾巴 UI，以及 opencode Agent 预设。已发布到 npm，可作为第三方插件市场源安装。

description.en: IDA Pro MCP bridge: decompile, disassemble, xrefs, strings and symbols from IDA straight into the agent session.
description.zh: IDA Pro MCP 桥接：在 Agent 会话里直接读 IDA 的反编译、反汇编、交叉引用、字符串与符号。

description.en: Android reverse engineering via the jadx MCP server: classes, methods, manifests and xrefs without leaving the session.
description.zh: Android 逆向 jadx MCP：在会话里查类、方法、Manifest 与引用，不用来回切工具。

description.en: Headless IDA analysis (idalib) as MCP tools for batch/scripted reverse-engineering flows.
description.zh: 无头 IDA 分析（idalib）MCP：给批量/脚本化逆向流程用的工具集。

description.en: Enables browser-use and computer-use: Playwright MCP plus macOS CUA control for real GUI driving.
description.zh: 启用浏览器与电脑控制：Playwright MCP 加 macOS CUA，真机级 GUI 操作。

description.en: Single-feature extract: whale-tail plugin-button icon (still + hover wiggle) and the stacked maid crest. No theme, coexists with other skins.
description.zh: 单功能摘取：鲸鱼尾巴插件按钮图标（静止 + 悬停摆动）与叠放女仆纹章。不带动效主题，可与其他皮肤共存。

description.en: One plugin, two agent presets ported from Bemly/opencode: nsfw (adult-fiction executor) and unrestricted (security-research executor).
description.zh: 一个插件，两个从 Bemly/opencode 移植的 Agent 预设：nsfw（成人小说执行器）与 unrestricted（安全研究执行器）。
